lines.learner: 요즘 살쪄서 고민이에요. 바지 치수가 달라졌어요.
lines.en: I've been gaining weight. My pants size changed.
lines.roman: yojeum saljjyeoseo gominieyo. baji chisuga dallajyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. How do you usually eat?
lines.learner: 저녁에 과식을 자주 해요. 식사량이 많아요.
lines.en: I often overeat at dinner. I eat a lot.
lines.roman: jeonyeoge gwasigeul jaju haeyo. siksaryangi manayo.

lines.beaver: 식사량을 줄여 보세요. 천천히 먹는 것도 좋아요.
lines.beaver_en: Try eating less. Eating slowly also helps.
lines.beaver_roman: siksaryangeul juryeo boseyo. cheoncheonhi meongneun geotdo joayo.
lines.learner: 천천히 먹으면 과식을 막을 수 있어요?
lines.en: If I eat slowly, can I prevent overeating?
lines.roman: cheoncheonhi meogeumyeon gwasigeul mageul su isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 틀림없이 도움이 될 거예요. 편식은 안 하세요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it will surely help. Are you a picky eater?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, teullimeopsi doumi doel geoyeyo. pyeonsigeun an haseyo?
lines.learner: 사실 편식을 해요. 채소를 잘 안 먹어요.
lines.en: Actually, I'm picky. I rarely eat vegetables.
lines.roman: sasil pyeonsigeul haeyo. chaesoreul jal an meogeoyo.

lines.beaver: 채소에는 영양이 많아요. 조금씩 드셔 보세요.
lines.beaver_en: Vegetables are very nutritious. Try a little at a time.
lines.beaver_roman: chaesoeneun yeongyangi manayo. jogeumssik deusyeo boseyo.
lines.en: I need to think about nutrition to get healthy.

lines.beaver_en: Right. Make sure to get vitamins too.
lines.en: Should I get vitamins from fruit?

lines.beaver: 과일이 좋아요. 아침에 사과 하나 어떠세요?
lines.beaver_en: Fruit is good. How about an apple in the morning?
lines.beaver_roman: gwairi joayo. achime sagwa hana eotteoseyo?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 아침을 먹어야 점심에 과식을 안 하겠죠?
lines.en: Good. If I eat breakfast, I won't overeat at lunch, right?
lines.roman: joayo. achimeul meogeoya jeomsime gwasigeul an hagetjyo?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, that's right. Do you exercise too?
lines.en: No. I guess I must exercise so I won't gain weight.

lines.beaver_en: If you keep at it, your habits will change.
lines.learner: 오늘부터 식사량을 줄이고 편식도 안 할게요.
lines.en: From today, I'll eat less and stop being picky.
lines.roman: oneulbuteo siksaryangeul jurigo pyeonsikdo an halgeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 다음 주에 다시 이야기해 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: Great. Let's talk again next week.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. daeum jue dasi iyagihae bwayo.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll come again next week.
